===== C:\Users\yakko\segal-react\src\assets\js\otp.js =====
//Initial references
const otpInputs = document.querySelectorAll(".otpInput");
const loginForm = document.getElementById("loginForm");
const otpHiddenInput = document.getElementById("otpHiddenInput");
const otpContainer = document.querySelector(".otpContainer");
let inputCount = 0,
  finalInput = "";

//Update input state
const updateInputConfig = (element, disabledStatus) => {
  element.disabled = disabledStatus;
  if (!disabledStatus) {
    element.focus();
  } else {
    element.blur();
  }
};

//Start inputs
const startInput = () => {
  inputCount = 0;
  finalInput = "";
  otpInputs.forEach((element) => {
    element.value = "";
  });
  updateInputConfig(otpContainer.firstElementChild, false);
};

//set value to hidden input
const setValue = () => {
  otpHiddenInput.value = finalInput;
};

otpInputs.forEach((input) => {
  input.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
    e.target.value = e.target.value.replace(/[^0-9]/g, "");
    let { value } = e.target;

    if (value.length == 1) {
      updateInputConfig(e.target, true);
      if (inputCount <= otpInputs.length - 1 && e.key != "Backspace") {
        finalInput += value;
        setValue();
        if (inputCount < otpInputs.length - 1) {
          updateInputConfig(e.target.nextElementSibling, false);
        }
      }
      inputCount += 1;
    } else if (value.length == 0 && e.key == "Backspace") {
      finalInput = finalInput.substring(0, finalInput.length - 1);
      setValue();
      if (inputCount == 0) {
        updateInputConfig(e.target, false);
        return false;
      }
      updateInputConfig(e.target, true);
      e.target.previousElementSibling.value = "";
      updateInputConfig(e.target.previousElementSibling, false);
      inputCount -= 1;
    } else if (value.length > 1) {
      e.target.value = value.split("")[0];
    }
  });
});

window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
  if (inputCount > otpInputs.length - 1) {
    // submit form on final char
    loginForm.submit();
    if (e.key == "Backspace") {
      finalInput = finalInput.substring(0, finalInput.length - 1);
      setValue();
      updateInputConfig(otpContainer.lastElementChild, false);
      otpContainer.lastElementChild.value = "";
      inputCount -= 1;
    }
  }
});

startInput();

// dropdown menu

let productMenu = document.getElementById('productMenu');
let dropdowns = document.querySelector('.dropdowns');
let dropdown1 = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown1 > li'));
let dropdown2 = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown2 > li'));
let accordionBtn = Array.from(document.getElementsByClassName('accordionBtn'));
let hamIcon = document.getElementById('hamIcon');
let mobileMenu = document.getElementById('mobileMenu');
let languageLi = document.querySelector('.nav-item.dropdown');

hamIcon.addEventListener('click', function () {
  mobileMenu.classList.toggle('active');
})

accordionBtn.forEach((item) => {
  item.addEventListener('click', function () {
    item.nextElementSibling.classList.toggle('active');
    item.querySelector('.bi-chevron-up').classList.toggle('active');
  })
})
productMenu.addEventListener('mouseover', function () {
  this.parentElement.nextElementSibling.classList.add('active');
})

dropdown1.forEach((item) => {
  item.addEventListener('mouseover', function () {
    dropdown1.forEach((li) => li.classList.remove('active'));
    item.classList.add('active');
    let tabId = item.dataset.id;
    dropdown2.forEach((content) => {
      let contentId = content.dataset.id;
      if (tabId === contentId) {
        content.classList.add('active');
      } else {
        content.classList.remove('active');
      }
    })
  })
});
dropdowns.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () {
  dropdowns.classList.remove('active');
})
languageLi.addEventListener('mouseover', function () {
  document.querySelector('.dropdowns').classList.remove('active');
})

// close toast
let closeIcon=Array.from(document.getElementsByClassName('bi-x'));

closeIcon.forEach((item)=>{
  item.addEventListener('click',function () {
    item.parentElement.classList.add('d-none');
  })
})

$(".compare-list").on("click", ".remove-compare-item", function () {
  console.log("here");
  const compareId = $(this).attr("compare-id");
  compareItems = compareItems.filter((item) => item != compareId);
  $(this).parent().remove();
  console.log($(this).parent(), $(this));
  if (!compareItems.length) $(".compare-modal").addClass("d-none");
});

  window.location.href = `./compare.html?ids=${compareItems.join(",")}`;
});

// Ø¹Ù†ÙˆØ§Ù† Ø¨Ø®Ø´ (Ø¨Ø§Ù„Ø§ÛŒ Ú©Ø§Ø±Øª)
function SectionTitle({ title, position }) {
  const isRight = position === 'right';
  return (
    <div
      className={`position-absolute -top-83 font-bold fs-20 text-white h-131 w-407 mx-2 ${
        !isRight ? 'left-27' : ''
      } aboutTitle`}
    >
      <img
        alt="shape"
        src="/assets/img/aboutShape2.png"
        className={`img-fluid position-absolute top-0 start-0 bottom-0 end-0 ${!isRight ? 'rotate-y-180' : ''}`}
      />
      <img
        alt="shape"
        src="/assets/img/aboutSvg.png"
        className={`img-fluid position-absolute top-0 ${isRight ? 'start-0' : 'end-0 rotate-y-180'}`}
      />
      <div
        className={`d-flex align-items-center ${
          isRight ? 'gap-2' : 'justify-content-end gap-2'
        } position-relative mt-sm-5 mt-4 pt-1 pt-sm-0`}
      >
        {isRight ? (
          <>
            <StackIcon />
            <p className="mb-0">{title}</p>
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <p className="mb-0">{title}</p>
            <StackIcon />
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// Ø§Ø³Ù„Ø§ÛŒØ¯Ø± ØªØµÙˆÛŒØ±
function ImageSlider({ image, id }) {
  return (
    <div className="col-lg-4 position-relative aboutSwiper py-4">
      <Swiper
        modules={[Pagination]}
        spaceBetween={10}
        slidesPerView={1}
        pagination={{ el: `.swiper-pagination-${id}`, clickable: true }}
        className="about"
      >
        {[1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
          <SwiperSlide key={i} className="position-relative">
            <a className="d-block">
              <img alt="slide" src={image} className="img-fluid w-100" />
            </a>
          </SwiperSlide>
        ))}
      </Swiper>
      <div className={`swiper-pagination-${id} position-absolute text-center`}></div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function AboutSection({ id, title, image, text, imageRight, titlePosition }) {
  return (
    <div className="container mt-5 pt-5">
      <div className="row mt-5 align-items-center position-relative end-0 rounded-33 bg-white shadow8 p-4">
        <SectionTitle title={title} position={titlePosition} />

        {/* ØªØµÙˆÛŒØ± */}
        {imageRight ? (
          <div className="col-lg-8 order-1 order-lg-0">
            <p className="text-gray lh-34 mb-0 fs-14 text-justify pe-sm-4 pt-3 pt-xl-0">
              {text}
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <ImageSlider image={image} id={id} />
        )}

        {/* Ù…ØªÙ† */}
        {imageRight ? (
          <ImageSlider image={image} id={id} />
        ) : (
          <div className="col-lg-8">
            <p className="text-gray lh-34 mb-0 fs-14 text-justify pe-sm-4 pt-3 pt-xl-0">
              {text}
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== C:\Users\yakko\segal-react\src\components\blog\BlogPagination.jsx =====
// src/components/blog/BlogPagination.jsx
export default function BlogPagination({ currentPage, totalPages, onPageChange }) {
  if (totalPages <= 1) return null;

  const pages = [];
  for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) pages.push(i);

  return (
    <div className="bg-white rounded-22 shadow8 h-68 mx-2 mt-4 overflow-hidden">
      <ul className="d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between mb-0 gap-sm-4 w-100 h-100 gap-3 fs-15 pagination pe-0 list-unstyled px-3">
        {/* Ù‚Ø¨Ù„ÛŒ */}
        <li className="h-100">
          <button
            disabled={currentPage === 1}
            onClick={() => onPageChange(currentPage - 1)}
            className="d-flex align-items-center gap-2 px-4 h-100 border-0 bg-transparent"
            style={{ opacity: currentPage === 1 ? 0.5 : 1 }}
          >
            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="16" viewBox="0 0 14 16" fill="none">
              <path
                d="M8.408 7.80005L5.29614 4.06672C5.07776 3.80005 4.7502 3.80005 4.53182 4.06672C4.31344 4.33338 4.31344 4.73338 4.53182 5.00005L7.20693 8.33338L4.53182 11.6667C4.31344 11.9334 4.31344 12.3334 4.53182 12.6C4.64101 12.7334 4.7502 12.8 4.91398 12.8C5.07776 12.8 5.18695 12.7334 5.29614 12.6L8.408 8.86672C8.62637 8.53338 8.62637 8.13338 8.408 7.80005Z"
                fill="#1E2D48"
              />
            </svg>
            <p className="mb-0 text-gray fs-15">Ù‚Ø¨Ù„</p>
          </button>
        </li>

        {/* Ø´Ù…Ø§Ø±Ù‡â€ŒÙ‡Ø§ */}
        {pages.map((page) => (
          <li key={page}>
            <button
              onClick={() => onPageChange(page)}
              className={`border-0 bg-transparent fs-15 ${
                currentPage === page ? 'text-main fw-bold' : 'text-gray'
              }`}
            >
              {page}
            </button>
          </li>
        ))}

        {/* Ø¨Ø¹Ø¯ÛŒ */}
        <li className="h-100">
          <button
            disabled={currentPage === totalPages}
            onClick={() => onPageChange(currentPage + 1)}
            className="d-flex align-items-center gap-2 px-4 h-100 border-0 bg-transparent"
            style={{ opacity: currentPage === totalPages ? 0.5 : 1 }}
          >
            <p className="mb-0 text-second fs-15">Ø¨Ø¹Ø¯</p>
            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="16" viewBox="0 0 14 16" fill="none">
              <path
                d="M4.77316 8.19995L7.88502 11.9333C8.10339 12.2 8.43096 12.2 8.64933 11.9333C8.86771 11.6666 8.86771 11.2666 8.64933 11L5.97423 7.66662L8.64933 4.33328C8.86771 4.06662 8.86771 3.66662 8.64933 3.39995C8.54015 3.26662 8.43096 3.19995 8.26717 3.19995C8.10339 3.19995 7.9942 3.26662 7.88502 3.39995L4.77316 7.13328C4.55478 7.46662 4.55478 7.86662 4.77316 8.19995Z"
                fill="url(#page-grad)"
              />
              <defs>
                <linearGradient id="page-grad" x1="4.60937" y1="11.0837" x2="9.77231" y2="10.3955" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
                  <stop stopColor="#5B6CCC" />
                  <stop offset="1" stopColor="#4834AC" />
                </linearGradient>
              </defs>
            </svg>
          </button>
        </li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

// src/components/blog/BlogSidebar.jsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { blogPosts, blogCategories } from '../../data/blogPosts';

export default function BlogSidebar({ activeCategory, onCategoryChange }) {
  const recentPosts = blogPosts.slice(0, 4);

  return (
    <div className="d-flex flex-column gap-4">
      {/* Ø¯Ø³ØªÙ‡â€ŒØ¨Ù†Ø¯ÛŒâ€ŒÙ‡Ø§ */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-21 shadow10 p-4">
        <h4 className="font-bold fs-16 mb-3">Ø¯Ø³ØªÙ‡â€ŒØ¨Ù†Ø¯ÛŒâ€ŒÙ‡Ø§</h4>
        <ul className="list-unstyled mb-0">
          {blogCategories.map((cat) => {
            const count = cat === 'Ù‡Ù…Ù‡' ? blogPosts.length : blogPosts.filter((p) => p.category === cat).length;
            return (
              <li key={cat} className="mb-2">
                <button
                  onClick={() => onCategoryChange(cat)}
                  className={`d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between w-100 border-0 bg-transparent rounded-8 py-2 px-2 fs-13 ${
                    activeCategory === cat ? 'bg-main3 fw-bold text-main' : 'text-gray'
                  }`}
                >
                  <span>{cat}</span>
                  <span className="fs-11">({count})</span>
                </button>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      </div>

      {/* Ø¢Ø®Ø±ÛŒÙ† Ù…Ù‚Ø§Ù„Ø§Øª */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-21 shadow10 p-4">
        <h4 className="font-bold fs-16 mb-3">Ø¢Ø®Ø±ÛŒÙ† Ù…Ù‚Ø§Ù„Ø§Øª</h4>
        <ul className="list-unstyled mb-0">
          {recentPosts.map((post) => (
            <li key={post.id} className="mb-3 pb-3 border-bottom">
              <Link to={`/blog/${post.id}`} className="d-flex gap-3 text-decoration-none">
                <img
                  src={post.image}

                  className="rounded-8"
                  style={{ width: 60, height: 60, objectFit: 'cover' }}

                    {post.title}
                  </p>
                  <p className="fs-11 text-gray mb-0">{post.date}</p>
                </div>
              </Link>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </div>

      {/* Ø®Ø¨Ø±Ù†Ø§Ù…Ù‡ */}
      <div className="bg-gradient-main rounded-21 shadow10 p-4 text-white">
        <h4 className="font-bold fs-16 mb-2">Ø¹Ø¶ÙˆÛŒØª Ø¯Ø± Ø®Ø¨Ø±Ù†Ø§Ù…Ù‡</h4>
        <p className="fs-12 mb-3" style={{ opacity: 0.8 }}>
          Ø¨Ø±Ø§ÛŒ Ø¯Ø±ÛŒØ§ÙØª Ø¬Ø¯ÛŒØ¯ØªØ±ÛŒÙ† Ù…Ù‚Ø§Ù„Ø§Øª Ø§ÛŒÙ…ÛŒÙ„ Ø®ÙˆØ¯ Ø±Ø§ ÙˆØ§Ø±Ø¯ Ú©Ù†ÛŒØ¯.
        </p>

          type="email"

// src/components/cart/ConfirmModal.jsx
export default function ConfirmModal({ isOpen, title, message, onConfirm, onCancel }) {
  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <>
      {/* Backdrop */}
      <div
        onClick={onCancel}
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          top: 0,
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          bottom: 0,
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)',
          zIndex: 9998,
          backdropFilter: 'blur(3px)',
        }}
      />

      {/* Modal */}
      <div
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          top: '50%',
          left: '50%',
          transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
          zIndex: 9999,
          width: '90%',
          maxWidth: 400,
        }}
      >
        <div className="bg-white rounded-21 shadow10 p-4">
          {/* Ø¢ÛŒÚ©ÙˆÙ† Ù‡Ø´Ø¯Ø§Ø± */}
          <div className="d-flex justify-content-center mb-3">
            <div
              className="rounded-circle d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center"
              style={{ width: 60, height: 60, backgroundColor: '#fee2e2' }}
            >
              <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none">
                <path
                  d="M12 2C6.48 2 2 6.48 2 12C2 17.52 6.48 22 12 22C17.52 22 22 17.52 22 12C22 6.48 17.52 2 12 2ZM13 17H11V15H13V17ZM13 13H11V7H13V13Z"
                  fill="#ef4444"
                />
              </svg>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Ø¹Ù†ÙˆØ§Ù† */}
          <h3 className="font-bold fs-18 text-center mb-2">{title || 'Ù…Ø·Ù…Ø¦Ù†ÛŒØŸ'}</h3>

          {/* Ù¾ÛŒØ§Ù… */}
          <p className="fs-14 text-gray text-center mb-4">{message}</p>

          {/* Ø¯Ú©Ù…Ù‡â€ŒÙ‡Ø§ */}
          <div className="d-flex gap-3">
            <button
              onClick={onCancel}
              className="flex-grow-1 border rounded-14 py-3 fs-14 fw-bold bg-white"
            >
              Ø§Ù†ØµØ±Ø§Ù
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={onConfirm}
              className="flex-grow-1 border-0 rounded-14 py-3 fs-14 fw-bold bg-danger text-white"
            >
              Ø¨Ù„Ù‡ØŒ Ø­Ø°Ù Ú©Ù†
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

function ServiceBullet({ isGradient }) {
  if (!isGradient) {
    return (
      <svg
        className="flex-shrink-0 mt-2"
        xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
        width="21"
        height="10"
        viewBox="0 0 21 10"
        fill="none"
      >
        <rect y="0.5" width="21" height="9" rx="4.5" fill="#27817A" />
      </svg>
    );
  }

  const gradientId = `gradient-bullet-${gradientCounter++}`;

  return (
    <svg
      className="flex-shrink-0 mt-2"
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      width="21"
      height="10"
      viewBox="0 0 21 10"
      fill="none"
    >
      <rect y="0.5" width="21" height="9" rx="4.5" fill={`url(#${gradientId})`} />
      <defs>
        <linearGradient
          id={gradientId}
          x1="0"
          y1="8.44259"
          x2="18.2683"
          y2="-3.63266"
          gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
        >
          <stop stopColor="#5B6CCC" />
          <stop offset="1" stopColor="#4834AC" />
        </linearGradient>
      </defs>
    </svg>
  );
}

                  fill="#27817A"
                />
              </svg>
            </a>
          </div>

          {/* Ø³ØªÙˆÙ† Ú†Ù¾ (Swiper Ø¯Ø³Ú©ØªØ§Ù¾) */}
          <div className="col-lg-9 d-none d-lg-block">
            <div className="position-relative h-100">
              <Swiper
                className="services p-1 h-100"
                modules={[Navigation, Pagination]}

                slidesPerView={3}
                navigation={{
                  nextEl: '.swiper-button-next3',
                  prevEl: '.swiper-button-prev3',
                }}
                pagination={{
                  el: '.swiper-pagination3',
                  clickable: true,
                }}
              >
                {services.map((service) => (
                  <SwiperSlide key={service.id}>
                    <div className="border overflow-hidden d-flex align-items-end rounded-25 h-100 bg-white position-relative">
                      <img
                        alt="shape"
                        src={service.shape}
                        className={`img-fluid position-absolute ${service.shapeWidth} top-0 ${service.shapePos} z-0`}
                      />
                      <div className="d-flex gap-2 position-relative z-10 p-4 mb-5">
                        <ServiceBullet isGradient={service.isGradient} />
                        <p className="fw-bold mb-0 fs-20">{service.text}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </SwiperSlide>
                ))}
              </Swiper>

              <div className="swiper-button-next3"></div>
              <div className="swiper-button-prev3"></div>
              <div className="swiper-pagination3"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

// src/components/layout/Header.jsx
import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useCart } from '../../context/CartContext';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';
import { useCompare } from '../../context/CompareContext';
import { useSearch } from '../../context/SearchContext';
import { useWishlist } from '../../context/WishlistContext';
import ProductMegaMenu from './ProductMegaMenu';
import SearchSuggestions from './SearchSuggestions';

export default function Header() {
  const { totalItems } = useCart();
  const { user, isLoggedIn, logout } = useAuth();
  const { compareList } = useCompare();
  const { wishlistCount } = useWishlist();
  const { searchQuery, setSearchQuery } = useSearch();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [showMegaMenu, setShowMegaMenu] = useState(false);
  const [showSuggestions, setShowSuggestions] = useState(false);
  const searchRef = useRef(null);

  // Ø¨Ø³ØªÙ† Ù¾ÛŒØ´Ù†Ù‡Ø§Ø¯Ù‡Ø§ Ø¨Ø§ Ú©Ù„ÛŒÚ© Ø¨ÛŒØ±ÙˆÙ†
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (e) => {
      if (searchRef.current && !searchRef.current.contains(e.target)) {
        setShowSuggestions(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const handleSearchSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      navigate(`/products?search=${encodeURIComponent(searchQuery.trim())}`);
      setShowSuggestions(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <header className="position-relative z-10">
      <div className="container">
        <div className="d-flex justify-content-between gap-3">
          <div className="flex-grow-1 w-100 position-relative">
            {/* ===== Ù†ÙˆØ§Ø± Ø¨Ø§Ù„Ø§ ===== */}

                  className="d-block rounded-8 p-2 fs-13 text-dark text-decoration-none hover-bg-gray"
                >
                  {sub}
                </Link>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// src/components/layout/SearchSuggestions.jsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { products } from '../../data/products';

export default function SearchSuggestions({ query, onSelect }) {
  if (!query.trim()) return null;

  const suggestions = products
    .filter((p) =>
      p.title.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) ||
      p.brand?.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())
    )
    .slice(0, 5);

  if (suggestions.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="position-absolute bg-white rounded-14 shadow10 p-3 mt-2 start-0 end-0" style={{ zIndex: 100 }}>
        <p className="fs-13 text-gray mb-0 text-center py-2">Ù†ØªÛŒØ¬Ù‡â€ŒØ§ÛŒ Ù¾ÛŒØ¯Ø§ Ù†Ø´Ø¯</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="position-absolute bg-white rounded-14 shadow10 mt-2 start-0 end-0" style={{ zIndex: 100, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
      {suggestions.map((product) => (
        <Link
          key={product.id}
          to={`/product/${product.id}`}
          onClick={onSelect}
          className="d-flex align-items-center gap-3 p-2 text-decoration-none border-bottom"
        >
          <img
            src={product.image}
            alt={product.title}
            style={{ width: 40, height: 40, objectFit: 'contain' }}
          />
          <div className="flex-grow-1">
            <p className="fs-13 mb-0 text-dark">{product.title}</p>
            <p className="fs-11 text-gray mb-0">{product.brand} â€¢ {product.category}</p>
          </div>
          <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none">
            <path d="M15 18L9 12L15 6" stroke="#ccc" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
          </svg>
        </Link>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

// ØªØ¨Ø¯ÛŒÙ„ Ø¹Ø¯Ø¯ Ø¨Ù‡ Ù‚ÛŒÙ…Øª ÙØ§Ø±Ø³ÛŒ Ø¨Ø§ Ø¬Ø¯Ø§Ú©Ù†Ù†Ø¯Ù‡ Ù‡Ø²Ø§Ø±Ú¯Ø§Ù†
export function formatPrice(num) {
  if (!num || num === 0) return 'Û°';
  return num.toLocaleString('fa-IR');
}

// Ø¯Ø±ØµØ¯ ØªØ®ÙÛŒÙ
function calcDiscount(price, oldPrice) {
  if (!oldPrice || oldPrice <= price) return 0;
  return Math.round(((oldPrice - price) / oldPrice) * 100);
}

export default function ProductCard({ product }) {
  const { addToCart } = useCart();
  const { addToCompare, removeFromCompare, isInCompare } = useCompare();
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const { toggleWishlist, isInWishlist } = useWishlist();
  const isComparing = isInCompare(product.id);
  const isWished = isInWishlist(product.id);

  const discount = calcDiscount(product.price, product.oldPrice);
  const hasPrice = product.price > 0;
  const inStock = product.stock !== false;

  const handleAddToCart = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!inStock) return;
    addToCart(product);
    showToast('Ø¨Ù‡ Ø³Ø¨Ø¯ Ø®Ø±ÛŒØ¯ Ø§Ø¶Ø§ÙÙ‡ Ø´Ø¯', 'success');
  };

  return (
    <div className="rounded-21 bg-white p-3 shadow10 position-relative h-100">
      {/* Ø¯Ú©Ù…Ù‡â€ŒÙ‡Ø§ÛŒ Compare Ùˆ Share */}
      <ul className="list-unstyled pe-0 mb-0 min-w-50 position-absolute start-0 left-ltr-auto z-10">
        <li>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="px-0 border-0 bg-transparent"
            title={isWished ? 'Ø­Ø°Ù Ø§Ø² Ø¹Ù„Ø§Ù‚Ù‡â€ŒÙ…Ù†Ø¯ÛŒ' : 'Ø§ÙØ²ÙˆØ¯Ù† Ø¨Ù‡ Ø¹Ù„Ø§Ù‚Ù‡â€ŒÙ…Ù†Ø¯ÛŒ'}
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              e.stopPropagation();
              const added = toggleWishlist(product);
              showToast(
                added ? 'Ø¨Ù‡ Ø¹Ù„Ø§Ù‚Ù‡â€ŒÙ…Ù†Ø¯ÛŒâ€ŒÙ‡Ø§ Ø§Ø¶Ø§ÙÙ‡ Ø´Ø¯' : 'Ø§Ø² Ø¹Ù„Ø§Ù‚Ù‡â€ŒÙ…Ù†Ø¯ÛŒâ€ŒÙ‡Ø§ Ø­Ø°Ù Ø´Ø¯',
                added ? 'success' : 'info'
              );
            }}
          >
            <svg
              xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
              width="24"
              height="24"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              fill={isWished ? '#ef4444' : 'none'}
              stroke={isWished ? '#ef4444' : '#000'}
              strokeWidth="2"
            >
              <path d="M20.84 4.61a5.5 5.5 0 0 0-7.78 0L12 5.67l-1.06-1.06a5.5 5.5 0 0 0-7.78 7.78l1.06 1.06L12 21.23l7.78-7.78 1.06-1.06a5.5 5.5 0 0 0 0-7.78z" />
            </svg>
          </button>
        </li>
        <li className="mb-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            className="px-0 border-0 bg-transparent"
            title={isComparing ? 'Ø­Ø°Ù Ø§Ø² Ù…Ù‚Ø§ÛŒØ³Ù‡' : 'Ø§ÙØ²ÙˆØ¯Ù† Ø¨Ù‡ Ù…Ù‚Ø§ÛŒØ³Ù‡'}
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              e.stopPropagation();
              if (isComparing) {
                removeFromCompare(product.id);
                showToast('Ø§Ø² Ù„ÛŒØ³Øª Ù…Ù‚Ø§ÛŒØ³Ù‡ Ø­Ø°Ù Ø´Ø¯', 'info');
              } else {
                addToCompare(product);
                showToast('Ø¨Ù‡ Ù„ÛŒØ³Øª Ù…Ù‚Ø§ÛŒØ³Ù‡ Ø§Ø¶Ø§ÙÙ‡ Ø´Ø¯', 'success');
              }
            }}
          >
            <div style={{ opacity: isComparing ? 0.5 : 1 }}>
              <CompareIcon />
            </div>
          </button>
        </li>
        <li>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="px-0 border-0 bg-transparent"
            title="Ø§Ø´ØªØ±Ø§Ú©â€ŒÚ¯Ø°Ø§Ø±ÛŒ"
          >
            <ShareIcon />
          </button>
        </li>
      </ul>

      {/* Ø¨Ø±Ú†Ø³Ø¨ ØªØ®ÙÛŒÙ */}
      {discount > 0 && hasPrice && (
        <span className="position-absolute top-0 end-0 bg-danger text-white fs-11 fw-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-bl-12 z-10 mt-2 me-2 rounded-pill">
          {discount}Ùª
        </span>
      )}

      <Link to={`/product/${product.id}`} className="text-decoration-none d-block">
        {/* ØªØµÙˆÛŒØ± */}
        <div className="d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center mt-4" style={{ height: 170 }}>
          <img
            alt={product.title}
            src={product.image}
            className="img-fluid mx-auto d-block"
            style={{ maxHeight: '100%', objectFit: 'contain' }}
            onError={(e) => {
              e.target.src = '/assets/img/related-product.png';
            }}
          />
        </div>

        {/* Ø¹Ù†ÙˆØ§Ù† */}
        <div className="fs-14 fw-bold text-black2 mt-4 h-65">
          {product.title}
        </div>
      </Link>

      {/* Ù‚ÛŒÙ…Øª / Ø¯Ú©Ù…Ù‡ */}
      {hasPrice ? (
        inStock ? (
          <div className="d-flex align-items-center gap-3 h-65">
            {/* Ø¯Ú©Ù…Ù‡ Ø§ÙØ²ÙˆØ¯Ù† Ø¨Ù‡ Ø³Ø¨Ø¯ */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleAddToCart}
              className="d-flex flex-shrink-0 align-items-center justify-content-center bg-white rounded-14 shadow8 w-38 h-38 border-0"
              title="Ø§ÙØ²ÙˆØ¯Ù† Ø¨Ù‡ Ø³Ø¨Ø¯"
            >
              <CartIcon />
            </button>

            {/* Ù‚ÛŒÙ…Øª */}
            <div className="flex-grow-1">
              {product.oldPrice > product.price && (
                <div className="d-flex align-items-center justify-content-end gap-2">
                  <p className="fs-12 text-gray text-decoration-line-through mb-0">
                    {formatPrice(product.oldPrice)}
                  </p>
                  <p className="mb-0 fs-11 fw-bold text-white bg-danger px-2 rounded-pill">
                    {discount}Ùª
                  </p>
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="d-flex align-items-end justify-content-end gap-1 mt-1">
                <p className="fs-17 font-bold mb-0">{formatPrice(product.price)}</p>
                <p className="mb-1 fs-12 fw-bold">ØªÙˆÙ…Ø§Ù†</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          // Ù†Ø§Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯
          <div className="d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center p-3 bg-white rounded-15 gap-2 fs-11 fw-bold text-second-gradient shadow8 h-65">
            <p className="mb-0">Ù†Ø§Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯</p>
          </div>

import { useState } from 'react';

import { FreeMode, Thumbs } from 'swiper/modules';
import { useCart } from '../../context/CartContext';

import 'swiper/css';
import 'swiper/css/free-mode';
import 'swiper/css/thumbs';

function formatPrice(num) {
  if (!num || num === 0) return 'Û°';
  return num.toLocaleString('fa-IR');
}

export default function ProductDetails({ product }) {
  const { addToCart } = useCart();
  const [thumbsSwiper, setThumbsSwiper] = useState(null);
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(1);

  const images = [product.image, product.image, product.image];
  const hasPrice = product.price > 0;
  const inStock = product.stock !== false;
  const discount = product.oldPrice > product.price
    ? Math.round(((product.oldPrice - product.price) / product.oldPrice) * 100)
    : 0;

    if (!inStock) return;

// src/components/product/RelatedProducts.jsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Swiper, SwiperSlide } from 'swiper/react';
import { Navigation } from 'swiper/modules';
import { products } from '../../data/products';
import ProductCard from './ProductCard';

import 'swiper/css';
import 'swiper/css/navigation';

export default function RelatedProducts({ currentProduct }) {
  const related = products
    .filter((p) => p.id !== currentProduct.id && p.category === currentProduct.category)
    .slice(0, 6);

  // Ø§Ú¯Ù‡ Ú©Ù…ØªØ± Ø§Ø² Û³ ØªØ§ Ø¨ÙˆØ¯ØŒ Ø§Ø² Ù‡Ù…Ù‡ Ù…Ø­ØµÙˆÙ„Ø§Øª Ø§Ø¶Ø§ÙÙ‡ Ú©Ù†
  const finalRelated = related.length >= 3
    ? related
    : products.filter((p) => p.id !== currentProduct.id).slice(0, 6);

  return (
    <div className="mt-5">
      <div className="rounded-19 bg-gray6 d-flex justify-content-between p-3 mb-4">
        <div className="mx-3">
          <p className="mb-1">
            <span className="font-bold">Ù…Ø­ØµÙˆÙ„Ø§Øª</span> Ù…Ø±ØªØ¨Ø·
          </p>
          <p className="fs-12 text-gray mb-0">Ù…Ø­ØµÙˆÙ„Ø§Øª Ù…Ø´Ø§Ø¨Ù‡ Ø§ÛŒÙ† Ù…Ø­ØµÙˆÙ„</p>
        </div>
        <Link
          to="/products"
          className="bg-white shadow8 text-dark px-3 rounded-14 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center gap-2 fs-13 text-decoration-none"
        >
          <p className="mb-0">Ù…Ø´Ø§Ù‡Ø¯Ù‡ Ù‡Ù…Ù‡</p>
        </Link>
      </div>

      <div className="bg-white rounded-20 shadow10 p-3">
        <Swiper
          modules={[Navigation]}
          spaceBetween={16}
          slidesPerView={1}
          breakpoints={{
            576: { slidesPerView: 2 },
            768: { slidesPerView: 3 },
            992: { slidesPerView: 4 },
          }}
          navigation
        >
          {finalRelated.map((p) => (
            <SwiperSlide key={p.id}>
              <ProductCard product={p} />
            </SwiperSlide>
          ))}
        </Swiper>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ÛŒÙ‡ Ø¢ÛŒØªÙ… Ø³Ø¨Ø¯
function CartItem({ item }) {
  const discount =
    item.oldPrice > item.price
      ? Math.round(((item.oldPrice - item.price) / item.oldPrice) * 100)
      : 0;

  return (
    <div className="d-flex flex-column flex-md-row gap-3 justify-content-between py-4 border-bottom">
      <div className="d-flex gap-5">
        <img
          alt={item.title}
          src={item.image}
          className="img-fluid"
          style={{ width: 80, height: 80, objectFit: 'contain' }}
        />
        <div>
          <Link
            to={`/product/${item.id}`}
            className="font-bold text-dark text-decoration-none"
          >
            {item.title}
          </Link>
          <div className="d-flex align-items-center gap-2 mt-2">
            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none">
              <path
                opacity="0.5"
                d="M2.815 4.23508C2.5 4.68341 2.5 6.01675 2.5 8.68091V9.99258C2.5 14.6909 6.0325 16.9717 8.24917 17.9392C8.85 18.2017 9.15083 18.3334 10 18.3334C10.85 18.3334 11.15 18.2017 11.7508 17.9392C13.9675 16.9709 17.5 14.6917 17.5 9.99258V8.68091C17.5 6.01591 17.5 4.68341 17.185 4.23508C16.8708 3.78758 15.6183 3.35841 13.1125 2.50091L12.635 2.33758C11.3292 1.89008 10.6767 1.66675 10 1.66675C9.32417 1.66675 8.67083 1.89008 7.365 2.33758L6.8875 2.50008C4.38167 3.35841 3.12917 3.78758 2.815 4.23508Z"
                fill="#27817A"
              />
            </svg>
            <p className="mb-0 text-gray fs-14">Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯ Ø¯Ø± Ø§Ù†Ø¨Ø§Ø± ÙØ±ÙˆØ´Ú¯Ø§Ù‡</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="d-flex justify-content-between flex-column">
        {/* ØªØ¹Ø¯Ø§Ø¯ */}
        <div className="d-flex align-items-center justify-content-end gap-2">
          <span className="w-22 h-22 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center bg-white border rounded-3 fs-14">
            {item.quantity}
          </span>
          <span className="fs-13 text-gray">Ø¹Ø¯Ø¯</span>
        </div>

        {/* Ù‚ÛŒÙ…Øª */}
        <div className="d-flex align-items-center justify-content-end justify-content-md-start mt-3 mt-md-0 gap-1">
          {discount > 0 && (
            <div className="d-flex align-items-center gap-2">
              <p className="fs-14 text-gray text-decoration-line-through mb-0">
                {formatPrice(item.oldPrice)}
              </p>
              <p className="mb-0 fs-13 fw-bold text-white bg-danger px-2 rounded-pill">
                {discount}Ùª
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="d-flex align-items-end gap-1">
            <p className="fs-20 font-bold mb-0">
              {formatPrice(item.price * item.quantity)}
            </p>
            <p className="mb-0 fs-14 fw-bold">ØªÙˆÙ…Ø§Ù†</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function MultiImages({ images }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex-shrink-0" style={{ minWidth: 80 }}>
      <div className="d-flex align-items-center gap-2 mb-2">
        <img alt="product" src={images[0]} className="img-fluid" style={{ width: 35, height: 35, objectFit: 'contain' }} />
        <img alt="product" src={images[1]} className="img-fluid" style={{ width: 35, height: 35, objectFit: 'contain' }} />
      </div>
      <div className="d-flex align-items-center gap-2">
        <img alt="product" src={images[2]} className="img-fluid" style={{ width: 35, height: 35, objectFit: 'contain' }} />
        <Link to="/orders" className="d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center border rounded-5 text-dark text-decoration-none" style={{ width: 35, height: 24 }}>
          <p className="mb-0 text-center">...</p>
        </Link>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function OrderItem({ order, isLast }) {
  return (
    <div className={`d-flex flex-column flex-md-row justify-content-between align-items-end align-items-md-start gap-3 py-3 ${!isLast ? 'border-bottom border-2' : ''}`}>
      <div className="d-flex gap-4 w-100">
        {order.type === 'multi' ? (
          <div className="ms-3 ms-md-0"><MultiImages images={order.images} /></div>
        ) : (
          <img alt="order" src={order.images[0]} className="img-fluid flex-shrink-0" style={{ width: 60, height: 60, objectFit: 'contain' }} />
        )}
        <div className="mt-2">
          <div className={`fs-11 d-inline-flex align-items-center justify-content-center gap-2 ${order.statusColor} rounded-9 py-1 px-2 text-white fw-300`}>
            <StatusIcon status={order.status} />
            <p className="mb-0">{order.statusLabel}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center gap-2 mt-2">
            <p className="mb-0 fs-14">{order.orderNumber}</p>

          <PriceIcon />
        </div>

const defaultStats = [
  { id: 1, value: 'Û±Û²Û³', label: 'Ø³ÙØ§Ø±Ø´ ØªÚ©Ù…ÛŒÙ„ Ø´Ø¯Ù‡', icon: 'done', active: true, href: '/orders' },

];

export default function ProfileStats({ data = defaultStats, className = '', handleClick }) {
  return (
    <div className={`d-flex flex-column flex-md-row align-items-center justify-content-between gap-4 ${className}`}>
      {data.map((item) => {
        const cardContent = (
          <>
            <div className="d-flex justify-content-between">
              <StatIcon name={item.icon} />
              <DotsIcon />
            </div>
            <p className="fs-24 font-bold text-dark mb-0 mt-3">{item.value}</p>
            <p className="text-gray mb-0">{item.label}</p>
          </>
        );

        const cardClass = `d-block flex-grow-1 w-100 rounded-20 p-4 dashboardSat shadow2 bg-white ${item.active ? 'active' : ''
          }`;

        // Ø§Ú¯Ù‡ href Ø¯Ø§Ø±Ù‡ â†’ Link
        if (item.href) {
          return (
            <Link
              key={item.id}
              to={item.href}
              className={cardClass}
              style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}
              onClick={handleClick ? () => handleClick(item) : undefined}
            >
              {cardContent}
            </Link>
          );
        }

        // ÙˆÚ¯Ø±Ù†Ù‡ â†’ div Ú©Ù„ÛŒÚ©â€ŒÙ¾Ø°ÛŒØ±
        return (
          <div
            key={item.id}
            className={cardClass}
            style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}
            onClick={handleClick ? () => handleClick(item) : undefined}
            role="button"
          >
            {cardContent}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

// src/components/ProtectedRoute.jsx
import { Navigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';

export default function ProtectedRoute({ children }) {
  const { isLoggedIn } = useAuth();
  const location = useLocation();

  if (!isLoggedIn) {
    // Ø°Ø®ÛŒØ±Ù‡ Ù…Ø³ÛŒØ± ÙØ¹Ù„ÛŒ Ø¨Ø±Ø§ÛŒ Ø¨Ø§Ø²Ú¯Ø´Øª Ø¨Ø¹Ø¯ Ø§Ø² Ù„Ø§Ú¯ÛŒÙ†
    return <Navigate to="/login" state={{ from: location.pathname }} replace />;
  }

  return children;
}

===== C:\Users\yakko\segal-react\src\context\AuthContext.jsx =====
// src/context/AuthContext.jsx
import { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from 'react';

const AuthContext = createContext();

export function AuthProvider({ children }) {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('segal-user');
      return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : null;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user) {
      localStorage.setItem('segal-user', JSON.stringify(user));
    } else {
      localStorage.removeItem('segal-user');
    }
  }, [user]);

  // ÙˆØ±ÙˆØ¯
  const login = (userData) => {
    setUser({
      id: userData.id || Date.now(),
      name: userData.name || 'Ú©Ø§Ø±Ø¨Ø±',
      phone: userData.phone || '',
      email: userData.email || '',
      isLoggedIn: true,
    });
  };

  // Ø®Ø±ÙˆØ¬
  const logout = () => {
    setUser(null);
  };

  // Ø¨Ø±Ø±Ø³ÛŒ ÙˆØ¶Ø¹ÛŒØª
  const isLoggedIn = !!user;

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={{ user, login, logout, isLoggedIn }}>
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
}

export const useAuth = () => {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useAuth Ø¨Ø§ÛŒØ¯ Ø¯Ø§Ø®Ù„ AuthProvider Ø§Ø³ØªÙØ§Ø¯Ù‡ Ø´ÙˆØ¯');
  }
  return context;
};

===== C:\Users\yakko\segal-react\src\context\CartContext.jsx =====
// src/context/CartContext.jsx
import { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from 'react';

const CartContext = createContext();

export function CartProvider({ children }) {
  const [cart, setCart] = useState(() => {
    // Ø¨Ø§Ø²ÛŒØ§Ø¨ÛŒ Ø³Ø¨Ø¯ Ø§Ø² localStorage
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('segal-cart');
      return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  });

  // Ø°Ø®ÛŒØ±Ù‡ Ø¯Ø± localStorage Ù‡Ø± Ø¨Ø§Ø± Ú©Ù‡ ØªØºÛŒÛŒØ± Ú©Ø±Ø¯
  useEffect(() => {
    localStorage.setItem('segal-cart', JSON.stringify(cart));
  }, [cart]);

  // Ø§ÙØ²ÙˆØ¯Ù† Ù…Ø­ØµÙˆÙ„
  const addToCart = (product) => {
    setCart((prev) => {
      const exists = prev.find((item) => item.id === product.id);
      if (exists) {
        return prev.map((item) =>
          item.id === product.id
            ? { ...item, quantity: item.quantity + 1 }
            : item
        );
      }
      return [...prev, { ...product, quantity: 1 }];
    });
  };

  // Ø­Ø°Ù Ù…Ø­ØµÙˆÙ„
  const removeFromCart = (id) => {
    setCart((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== id));
  };

  // ØªØºÛŒÛŒØ± ØªØ¹Ø¯Ø§Ø¯
  const updateQuantity = (id, quantity) => {
    if (quantity <= 0) {
      removeFromCart(id);
      return;
    }
    setCart((prev) =>
      prev.map((item) =>
        item.id === id ? { ...item, quantity } : item
      )
    );
  };

  // Ø®Ø§Ù„ÛŒ Ú©Ø±Ø¯Ù† Ø³Ø¨Ø¯
  const clearCart = () => setCart([]);

  // ØªØ¹Ø¯Ø§Ø¯ Ú©Ù„ Ø¢ÛŒØªÙ…â€ŒÙ‡Ø§
  const totalItems = cart.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.quantity, 0);

  // Ù‚ÛŒÙ…Øª Ú©Ù„
  const totalPrice = cart.reduce(
    (sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.quantity,
    0
  );

  return (
    <CartContext.Provider
      value={{
        cart,
        addToCart,
        removeFromCart,
        updateQuantity,
        clearCart,
        totalItems,
        totalPrice,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </CartContext.Provider>
  );
}

export const useCart = () => {
  const context = useContext(CartContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useCart Ø¨Ø§ÛŒØ¯ Ø¯Ø§Ø®Ù„ CartProvider Ø§Ø³ØªÙØ§Ø¯Ù‡ Ø´ÙˆØ¯');
  }
  return context;
};

// src/context/CompareContext.jsx
import { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from 'react';

const CompareContext = createContext();

const MAX_COMPARE = 4; // Ø­Ø¯Ø§Ú©Ø«Ø± Û´ Ù…Ø­ØµÙˆÙ„

export function CompareProvider({ children }) {
  const [compareList, setCompareList] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('segal-compare');
      return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    localStorage.setItem('segal-compare', JSON.stringify(compareList));
  }, [compareList]);

  // Ø§ÙØ²ÙˆØ¯Ù† Ø¨Ù‡ Ù…Ù‚Ø§ÛŒØ³Ù‡
  const addToCompare = (product) => {
    setCompareList((prev) => {
      // Ø§Ú¯Ù‡ Ø§Ø² Ù‚Ø¨Ù„ Ù‡Ø³ØªØŒ Ú©Ø§Ø±ÛŒ Ù†Ú©Ù†
      if (prev.find((p) => p.id === product.id)) {
        return prev;
      }
      // Ø§Ú¯Ù‡ Ø¨Ù‡ Ø­Ø¯Ø§Ú©Ø«Ø± Ø±Ø³ÛŒØ¯Ù‡ØŒ Ø§Ø¬Ø§Ø²Ù‡ Ù†Ø¯Ù‡
      if (prev.length >= MAX_COMPARE) {
        alert(`Ø­Ø¯Ø§Ú©Ø«Ø± ${MAX_COMPARE} Ù…Ø­ØµÙˆÙ„ Ù…ÛŒâ€ŒØªÙˆÙ†ÛŒ Ù…Ù‚Ø§ÛŒØ³Ù‡ Ú©Ù†ÛŒ`);
        return prev;
      }
      return [...prev, product];
    });
  };

  // Ø­Ø°Ù Ø§Ø² Ù…Ù‚Ø§ÛŒØ³Ù‡
  const removeFromCompare = (id) => {
    setCompareList((prev) => prev.filter((p) => p.id !== id));
  };

  // Ù¾Ø§Ú© Ú©Ø±Ø¯Ù† Ù‡Ù…Ù‡
  const clearCompare = () => setCompareList([]);

  // Ø¨Ø±Ø±Ø³ÛŒ Ø§ÛŒÙ†Ú©Ù‡ Ø¢ÛŒØ§ Ù…Ø­ØµÙˆÙ„ ØªÙˆÛŒ Ù„ÛŒØ³Øª Ù‡Ø³Øª
  const isInCompare = (id) => compareList.some((p) => p.id === id);

  return (
    <CompareContext.Provider
      value={{
        compareList,
        addToCompare,
        removeFromCompare,
        clearCompare,
        isInCompare,
        maxCompare: MAX_COMPARE,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </CompareContext.Provider>
  );
}

export const useCompare = () => {
  const context = useContext(CompareContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useCompare Ø¨Ø§ÛŒØ¯ Ø¯Ø§Ø®Ù„ CompareProvider Ø§Ø³ØªÙØ§Ø¯Ù‡ Ø´ÙˆØ¯');
  }
  return context;

// src/context/ToastContext.jsx
import { createContext, useContext, useState, useCallback } from 'react';

const ToastContext = createContext();

export function ToastProvider({ children }) {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState([]);

  const showToast = useCallback((message, type = 'success', duration = 3000) => {
    const id = Date.now() + Math.random();
    setToasts((prev) => [...prev, { id, message, type }]);

    setTimeout(() => {
      setToasts((prev) => prev.filter((t) => t.id !== id));
    }, duration);
  }, []);

  const removeToast = (id) => {
    setToasts((prev) => prev.filter((t) => t.id !== id));
  };

  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider value={{ showToast }}>
      {children}

      {/* Ù†Ù…Ø§ÛŒØ´ Toastâ€ŒÙ‡Ø§ */}
      <div
        className="position-fixed z-20 d-flex flex-column gap-2"
        style={{ top: 20, left: '50%', transform: 'translateX(-50%)', minWidth: 300, maxWidth: 400 }}
      >
        {toasts.map((toast) => (
          <div
            key={toast.id}
            onClick={() => removeToast(toast.id)}
            className={`rounded-14 shadow10 py-3 px-4 d-flex align-items-center gap-3 text-white cursor-pointer ${
              toast.type === 'success'
                ? 'bg-second2'
                : toast.type === 'error'
                ? 'bg-danger'
                : toast.type === 'warning'
                ? 'bg-warning text-dark'
                : 'bg-gradient-main'
            }`}
            style={{ animation: 'slideDown 0.3s ease-out' }}
          >
            {/* Ø¢ÛŒÚ©ÙˆÙ† */}
            {toast.type === 'success' && (
              <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none">
                <path
                  d="M12 2C6.48 2 2 6.48 2 12C2 17.52 6.48 22 12 22C17.52 22 22 17.52 22 12C22 6.48 17.52 2 12 2ZM10 17L5 12L6.41 10.59L10 14.17L17.59 6.58L19 8L10 17Z"
                  fill="white"
                />
              </svg>
            )}
            {toast.type === 'error' && (
              <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none">
                <path
                  d="M12 2C6.48 2 2 6.48 2 12C2 17.52 6.48 22 12 22C17.52 22 22 17.52 22 12C22 6.48 17.52 2 12 2ZM13 17H11V15H13V17ZM13 13H11V7H13V13Z"
                  fill="white"
                />
              </svg>
            )}
            {toast.type === 'warning' && (
              <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none">
                <path
                  d="M1 21H23L12 2L1 21ZM13 18H11V16H13V18ZM13 14H11V10H13V14Z"
                  fill="black"
                />
              </svg>
            )}
            {toast.type === 'info' && (
              <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none">
                <path
                  d="M12 2C6.48 2 2 6.48 2 12C2 17.52 6.48 22 12 22C17.52 22 22 17.52 22 12C22 6.48 17.52 2 12 2ZM13 17H11V11H13V17ZM13 9H11V7H13V9Z"
                  fill="white"
                />
              </svg>
            )}

            <p className="mb-0 fs-14 fw-medium flex-grow-1">{toast.message}</p>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* CSS animation */}
      <style>{`
        @keyframes slideDown {
          from {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(-20px);
          }
          to {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
          }
        }
      `}</style>
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  );
}

export const useToast = () => {
  const context = useContext(ToastContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useToast Ø¨Ø§ÛŒØ¯ Ø¯Ø§Ø®Ù„ ToastProvider Ø§Ø³ØªÙØ§Ø¯Ù‡ Ø´ÙˆØ¯');
  }
  return context;
};

// src/context/WishlistContext.jsx
import { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from 'react';

const WishlistContext = createContext();

export function WishlistProvider({ children }) {
  const [wishlist, setWishlist] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('segal-wishlist');
      return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    localStorage.setItem('segal-wishlist', JSON.stringify(wishlist));
  }, [wishlist]);

  // Ø§ÙØ²ÙˆØ¯Ù† Ø¨Ù‡ Ø¹Ù„Ø§Ù‚Ù‡â€ŒÙ…Ù†Ø¯ÛŒ
  const addToWishlist = (product) => {
    setWishlist((prev) => {
      if (prev.find((p) => p.id === product.id)) return prev;
      return [...prev, product];
    });
  };

  // Ø­Ø°Ù Ø§Ø² Ø¹Ù„Ø§Ù‚Ù‡â€ŒÙ…Ù†Ø¯ÛŒ
  const removeFromWishlist = (id) => {
    setWishlist((prev) => prev.filter((p) => p.id !== id));
  };

  // toggle
  const toggleWishlist = (product) => {
    if (isInWishlist(product.id)) {
      removeFromWishlist(product.id);
      return false;
    } else {
      addToWishlist(product);
      return true;
    }
  };

  // Ù¾Ø§Ú© Ú©Ø±Ø¯Ù† Ù‡Ù…Ù‡
  const clearWishlist = () => setWishlist([]);

  // Ø¨Ø±Ø±Ø³ÛŒ ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯
  const isInWishlist = (id) => wishlist.some((p) => p.id === id);

  return (
    <WishlistContext.Provider
      value={{
        wishlist,
        addToWishlist,
        removeFromWishlist,
        toggleWishlist,
        clearWishlist,
        isInWishlist,
        wishlistCount: wishlist.length,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </WishlistContext.Provider>
  );
}

export const useWishlist = () => {
  const context = useContext(WishlistContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useWishlist Ø¨Ø§ÛŒØ¯ Ø¯Ø§Ø®Ù„ WishlistProvider Ø§Ø³ØªÙØ§Ø¯Ù‡ Ø´ÙˆØ¯');
  }
  return context;
};

// src/pages/Blog.jsx
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import BlogBanner from '../components/blog/BlogBanner';
import BlogCard from '../components/blog/BlogCard';
import BlogPagination from '../components/blog/BlogPagination';
import BlogSidebar from '../components/blog/BlogSidebar';
import BlogSearchBox from '../components/blog/BlogSearchBox';
import Shoar from '../components/home/Shoar';
import { blogPosts } from '../data/blogPosts';
import SEO from '../components/SEO';

const POSTS_PER_PAGE = 6;

export default function Blog() {
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();

  const [search, setSearch] = useState(searchParams.get('search') || '');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState(searchParams.get('category') || 'Ù‡Ù…Ù‡');
  const [sort, setSort] = useState(searchParams.get('sort') || 'newest');
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);

  // Ù‡Ù…Ú¯Ø§Ù…â€ŒØ³Ø§Ø²ÛŒ Ø¨Ø§ URL
  useEffect(() => {
    const params = {};
    if (search) params.search = search;
    if (category !== 'Ù‡Ù…Ù‡') params.category = category;
    if (sort !== 'newest') params.sort = sort;
    setSearchParams(params, { replace: true });
    setCurrentPage(1); // Ø¨Ø±Ú¯Ø´Øª Ø¨Ù‡ ØµÙØ­Ù‡ Û± Ø¨Ø§ ØªØºÛŒÛŒØ± ÙÛŒÙ„ØªØ±
  }, [search, category, sort]);

  // ÙÛŒÙ„ØªØ± Ùˆ Ù…Ø±ØªØ¨â€ŒØ³Ø§Ø²ÛŒ
  let filtered = blogPosts.filter((post) => {
    const matchesSearch = !search.trim() || post.title.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase());
    const matchesCategory = category === 'Ù‡Ù…Ù‡' || post.category === category;
    return matchesSearch && matchesCategory;
  });

  // Ù…Ø±ØªØ¨â€ŒØ³Ø§Ø²ÛŒ
  if (sort === 'oldest') filtered = [...filtered].reverse();
  if (sort === 'popular') {
    filtered = [...filtered].sort((a, b) => {
      const aViews = parseInt(a.views.replace(/[^\d]/g, '')) || 0;
      const bViews = parseInt(b.views.replace(/[^\d]/g, '')) || 0;
      return bViews - aViews;
    });
  }

  // Pagination
  const totalPages = Math.ceil(filtered.length / POSTS_PER_PAGE);
  const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * POSTS_PER_PAGE;
  const paginatedPosts = filtered.slice(startIndex, startIndex + POSTS_PER_PAGE);

  return (
    <>
      <SEO
        title="ÙˆØ¨Ù„Ø§Ú¯ | Ø³Ú¯Ø§Ù„"
        description="Ø¢Ø®Ø±ÛŒÙ† Ù…Ù‚Ø§Ù„Ø§Øª Ùˆ Ø§Ø®Ø¨Ø§Ø± Ø¯Ù†ÛŒØ§ÛŒ Ø¨Ø±Ù‚ Ùˆ Ø§ØªÙˆÙ…Ø§Ø³ÛŒÙˆÙ†"
      />
      <main className="mt-4 position-relative">
        <BlogBanner />

        <section id="blog" className="-mt-126 position-relative">
          <div className="container">
            <div className="row g-4">
              {/* Ø³ØªÙˆÙ† Ù…Ø­ØªÙˆØ§ */}
              <div className="col-lg-8">
                {/* Ø³Ø±Ú†â€ŒØ¨Ø§Ú©Ø³ */}
                <BlogSearchBox
                  search={search}
                  onSearchChange={setSearch}
                  sort={sort}
                  onSortChange={setSort}
                />

                {/* Ù†Ù…Ø§ÛŒØ´ ØªØ¹Ø¯Ø§Ø¯ */}
                {filtered.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="bg-white rounded-21 shadow10 p-5 text-center">
                    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="60" height="60" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" className="mb-3">
                      <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8" stroke="#ccc" strokeWidth="2" />
                      <path d="M21 21L16.65 16.65" stroke="#ccc" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" />
                    </svg>
                    <p className="fs-16 font-bold mb-2">Ù…Ù‚Ø§Ù„Ù‡â€ŒØ§ÛŒ ÛŒØ§ÙØª Ù†Ø´Ø¯</p>
                    <p className="fs-14 text-gray mb-4">
                      {search ? `Ø¨Ø±Ø§ÛŒ "${search}" Ù†ØªÛŒØ¬Ù‡â€ŒØ§ÛŒ Ù¾ÛŒØ¯Ø§ Ù†Ú©Ø±Ø¯ÛŒÙ…` : 'Ø¯Ø± Ø§ÛŒÙ† Ø¯Ø³ØªÙ‡â€ŒØ¨Ù†Ø¯ÛŒ Ù…Ù‚Ø§Ù„Ù‡â€ŒØ§ÛŒ Ù†ÛŒØ³Øª'}
                    </p>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => {
                        setSearch('');
                        setCategory('Ù‡Ù…Ù‡');
                      }}
                      className="bg-gradient-main text-white rounded-14 border-0 py-2 px-4 fs-14 fw-bold"
                    >
                      Ù†Ù…Ø§ÛŒØ´ Ù‡Ù…Ù‡ Ù…Ù‚Ø§Ù„Ø§Øª
                    </button>

                        <button
                          onClick={() => setSearch('')}

                        >
                          Ù¾Ø§Ú© Ú©Ø±Ø¯Ù† Ø¬Ø³ØªØ¬Ùˆ

            </div>

        </section>

        <img
          alt="wave"
          src="/assets/img/footerWave.png"
          className="img-fluid w-100 position-absolute -bottom-210 end-0 start-0 d-md-block d-none"
        />
        <img
          alt="wave"
          src="/assets/img/footerBg2.png"
          className="img-fluid w-100 position-absolute -bottom-210 end-0 start-0 d-block d-md-none"
        />
      </main>
    </>

// src/pages/Cart.jsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useCart } from '../context/CartContext';
import { useToast } from '../context/ToastContext';
import ConfirmModal from '../components/cart/ConfirmModal';

function formatPrice(num) {
  if (!num || num === 0) return 'Û°';
  return num.toLocaleString('fa-IR');
}

export default function Cart() {
  const { cart, removeFromCart, updateQuantity, clearCart, totalItems, totalPrice } = useCart();

// src/pages/Checkout.jsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useCart } from '../context/CartContext';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { useToast } from '../context/ToastContext';

function formatPrice(num) {
  if (!num || num === 0) return 'Û°';
  return num.toLocaleString('fa-IR');
}

export default function Checkout() {
  const { cart, totalPrice, clearCart } = useCart();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [step, setStep] = useState(1); // 1: Ø¢Ø¯Ø±Ø³ØŒ 2: Ù¾Ø±Ø¯Ø§Ø®ØªØŒ 3: Ù…ÙˆÙÙ‚
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    fullName: user?.name || '',
    phone: user?.phone || '',
    province: 'ØªÙ‡Ø±Ø§Ù†',
    city: 'ØªÙ‡Ø±Ø§Ù†',
    address: '',
    postalCode: '',
    paymentMethod: 'zarinpal',
  });

  const [orderNumber] = useState(() => Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000));

  const handleChange = (e) => {
    setForm({ ...form, [e.target.name]: e.target.value });
  };

  const handleAddressSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!form.address.trim() || !form.postalCode.trim()) {
      showToast('Ù„Ø·ÙØ§ Ø¢Ø¯Ø±Ø³ Ùˆ Ú©Ø¯ Ù¾Ø³ØªÛŒ Ø±Ø§ Ú©Ø§Ù…Ù„ ÙˆØ§Ø±Ø¯ Ú©Ù†ÛŒØ¯', 'error');
      return;
    }
    setStep(2);
  };

  const handlePaymentSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (cart.length === 0) {
      showToast('Ø³Ø¨Ø¯ Ø®Ø±ÛŒØ¯ Ø®Ø§Ù„ÛŒ Ø§Ø³Øª', 'error');
      return;
    }

import { useToast } from '../context/ToastContext';

===== C:\Users\yakko\segal-react\src\pages\Products.jsx =====
// src/pages/Products.jsx
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { products } from '../data/products';
import ProductCard from '../components/product/ProductCard';
import ProductNumbers from '../components/product/ProductNumbers';
import { useSearch } from '../context/SearchContext';

export default function Products() {
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const { searchQuery, setSearchQuery } = useSearch();
  const [localSearch, setLocalSearch] = useState('');

  // Ù‡Ù…Ú¯Ø§Ù…â€ŒØ³Ø§Ø²ÛŒ Ø¨Ø§ query string
  useEffect(() => {
    const queryFromUrl = searchParams.get('search') || '';
    if (queryFromUrl) {
      setLocalSearch(queryFromUrl);
      setSearchQuery(queryFromUrl);
    } else {
      setLocalSearch(searchQuery);
    }
  }, [searchParams]);

  const handleSearchChange = (e) => {
    const value = e.target.value;
    setLocalSearch(value);
    setSearchQuery(value);
  };

  // ÙÛŒÙ„ØªØ± Ù…Ø­ØµÙˆÙ„Ø§Øª
  const filtered = products.filter((p) => {
    if (!localSearch.trim()) return true;
    const search = localSearch.toLowerCase();
    return (
      p.title.toLowerCase().includes(search) ||
      p.brand?.toLowerCase().includes(search) ||
      p.category?.toLowerCase().includes(search)
    );
  });

  return (
    <main className="mt-4 position-relative">
      <section className="container pt-md-3">
        <ProductNumbers />
      </section>

      <section className="container mt-4">
        <div className="row g-4">
          {/* ÙÛŒÙ„ØªØ± */}
          <div className="col-lg-3">
            <form className="rounded-21 shadow10 p-3 bg-white">
              <div className="rounded-21 bg-gradient-main h-76 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center gap-3 fs-15 fw-bold text-white mb-3">
                <p className="mb-0">ÙÛŒÙ„ØªØ± Ù†ØªØ§ÛŒØ¬ Ø¬Ø³ØªØ¬Ùˆ</p>
              </div>

              <div className="rounded-14 h-57 d-flex align-items-center fs-14 p-3 bg-gray5 mb-3">
                <input
                  value={localSearch}
                  onChange={handleSearchChange}
                  placeholder="Ø¬Ø³ØªØ¬Ùˆ Ø¯Ø± Ø¹Ù†Ø§ÙˆÛŒÙ† ..."
                  className="w-100 flex-grow-1 bg-transparent border-0 outline-none"
                />
              </div>

              {['Ù‚ÛŒÙ…Øª', 'Ø±Ù†Ú¯', 'Ø¨Ø±Ù†Ø¯', 'Ø§Ù…ØªÛŒØ§Ø²', 'Ù†ÙˆØ¹'].map((filterName) => (
                <div key={filterName} className="fs-15">
                  <div className="d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between cursor-pointer py-3 border-bottom border-2">
                    <p className="mb-0">{filterName}</p>
                    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="10" height="6" viewBox="0 0 10 6" fill="none">
                      <path
                        fillRule="evenodd"
                        clipRule="evenodd"
                        d="M0.230169 0.209376C0.528748 -0.0777189 1.00353 -0.0684095 1.29063 0.230169L5 4.16792L8.70938 0.230169C8.99647 -0.0684094 9.47125 -0.0777189 9.76983 0.209376C10.0684 0.496471 10.0777 0.971254 9.79063 1.26983L5.54063 5.76983C5.39922 5.91689 5.20401 6 5 6C4.79599 6 4.60078 5.91689 4.45938 5.76983L0.209376 1.26983C-0.0777189 0.971254 -0.0684095 0.496471 0.230169 0.209376Z"
                        fill="#0F172A"
                      />
                    </svg>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}

              <button
                type="submit"
                className="bg-gradient-main text-white rounded-21 border-0 w-100 p-3 font-bold mt-4"
              >
                Ø¬Ø³ØªØ¬Ùˆ
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>

          {/* Ú¯Ø±ÛŒØ¯ Ù…Ø­ØµÙˆÙ„Ø§Øª */}
          <div className="col-lg-9">
            {/* Ù†Ù…Ø§ÛŒØ´ Ø¹Ù†ÙˆØ§Ù† Ø¬Ø³ØªØ¬Ùˆ */}
            {localSearch.trim() && (
              <div className="d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between mb-3 px-2 position-relative">
                <p className="mb-0 fs-14">
                  Ù†ØªØ§ÛŒØ¬ Ø¨Ø±Ø§ÛŒ: <span className="font-bold text-main">"{localSearch}"</span>
                  <span className="text-gray"> ({filtered.length} Ù…Ø­ØµÙˆÙ„)</span>
                </p>
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    setLocalSearch('');
                    setSearchQuery('');
                  }}
                  className="fs-12 text-danger border-0 bg-transparent p-0 fw-bold"
                >
                  Ù¾Ø§Ú© Ú©Ø±Ø¯Ù†
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            {filtered.length > 0 ? (
              <div className="row g-4">
                {filtered.map((product) => (
                  <div key={product.id} className="col-12 col-sm-6 col-lg-4">
                    <ProductCard product={product} />
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="bg-white shadow8 rounded-21 text-center py-5 px-3">
                <svg
                  xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                  width="60"
                  height="60"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  fill="none"
                  className="mb-3"
                >
                  <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8" stroke="#27817A" strokeWidth="2" opacity="0.5" />
                  <path d="M21 21L16.65 16.65" stroke="#27817A" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" />
                </svg>
                <p className="fs-18 font-bold mb-2">Ù†ØªÛŒØ¬Ù‡â€ŒØ§ÛŒ ÛŒØ§ÙØª Ù†Ø´Ø¯</p>
                <p className="text-gray mb-3">
                  Ø¨Ø±Ø§ÛŒ "{localSearch}" Ù…Ø­ØµÙˆÙ„ÛŒ Ù¾ÛŒØ¯Ø§ Ù†Ú©Ø±Ø¯ÛŒÙ…
                </p>
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    setLocalSearch('');
                    setSearchQuery('');
                  }}
                  className="bg-gradient-main text-white rounded-pill border-0 px-4 py-2 fs-14"
                >
                  Ù†Ù…Ø§ÛŒØ´ Ù‡Ù…Ù‡ Ù…Ø­ØµÙˆÙ„Ø§Øª
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}

// src/App.jsx
import { lazy, Suspense } from 'react';
import { Routes, Route } from 'react-router-dom';

// ContextÙ‡Ø§
import { CartProvider } from './context/CartContext';
import { AuthProvider } from './context/AuthContext';
import { CompareProvider } from './context/CompareContext';
import { SearchProvider } from './context/SearchContext';
import { WishlistProvider } from './context/WishlistContext';
import { ToastProvider } from './context/ToastContext';

// Ú©Ø§Ù…Ù¾ÙˆÙ†Ù†Øªâ€ŒÙ‡Ø§ (Ù‡Ù…ÛŒØ´Ù‡ Ù„ÙˆØ¯ Ù…ÛŒâ€ŒØ´Ù†)
import Layout from './components/layout/Layout';
import ProtectedRoute from './components/ProtectedRoute';

// ØµÙØ­Ø§Øª (Lazy - ÙÙ‚Ø· ÙˆÙ‚ØªÛŒ Ù„Ø§Ø²Ù… Ø´Ø¯ Ù„ÙˆØ¯ Ù…ÛŒâ€ŒØ´Ù†)
const Home = lazy(() => import('./pages/Home'));
const Products = lazy(() => import('./pages/Products'));
const SingleProduct = lazy(() => import('./pages/SingleProduct'));
const Cart = lazy(() => import('./pages/Cart'));
const Checkout = lazy(() => import('./pages/Checkout'));
const Login = lazy(() => import('./pages/Login'));
const Profile = lazy(() => import('./pages/Profile'));
const ProfileInfo = lazy(() => import('./pages/ProfileInfo'));
const ProfileAddresses = lazy(() => import('./pages/ProfileAddresses'));
const ProfileHistory = lazy(() => import('./pages/ProfileHistory'));
const SavedProducts = lazy(() => import('./pages/SavedProducts'));
const About = lazy(() => import('./pages/About'));
const Contact = lazy(() => import('./pages/Contact'));
const Vitrin = lazy(() => import('./pages/Vitrin'));
const Blog = lazy(() => import('./pages/Blog'));
const SingleBlog = lazy(() => import('./pages/SingleBlog'));
const Compare = lazy(() => import('./pages/Compare'));
const MyOrders = lazy(() => import('./pages/MyOrders'));
const NotFound = lazy(() => import('./pages/NotFound'));

// Ú©Ø§Ù…Ù¾ÙˆÙ†Ù†Øª Loading
function LoadingFallback() {
  return (
    <div
      className="d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center"
      style={{ minHeight: '60vh' }}
    >
      <div className="text-center">
        <div
          className="spinner-border text-main"
          role="status"
          style={{ width: 50, height: 50 }}
        ></div>
        <p className="mt-3 text-gray fs-14">Ø¯Ø± Ø­Ø§Ù„ Ø¨Ø§Ø±Ú¯Ø°Ø§Ø±ÛŒ...</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function App() {
  return (
    <ToastProvider>
      <AuthProvider>
        <CartProvider>
          <WishlistProvider>
            <CompareProvider>
              <SearchProvider>
                <Suspense fallback={<LoadingFallback />}>
                  <Routes>
                    <Route element={<Layout />}>
                      {/* âœ… ØµÙØ­Ø§Øª Ø¹Ù…ÙˆÙ…ÛŒ */}
                      <Route path="/" element={<Home />} />
                      <Route path="/products" element={<Products />} />
                      <Route path="/product/:id" element={<SingleProduct />} />
                      <Route path="/about" element={<About />} />
                      <Route path="/contact" element={<Contact />} />
                      <Route path="/vitrin" element={<Vitrin />} />
                      <Route path="/blog" element={<Blog />} />
                      <Route path="/blog/:id" element={<SingleBlog />} />
                      <Route path="/login" element={<Login />} />

                      {/* ðŸ”’ ØµÙØ­Ø§Øª Ù…Ø­Ø§ÙØ¸Øªâ€ŒØ´Ø¯Ù‡ */}
                      <Route
                        path="/profile"
                        element={
                          <ProtectedRoute>
                            <Profile />
                          </ProtectedRoute>
                        }
                      />
                      <Route
                        path="/profile/info"
                        element={
                          <ProtectedRoute>
                            <ProfileInfo />
                          </ProtectedRoute>
                        }
                      />
                      <Route
                        path="/profile/addresses"
                        element={
                          <ProtectedRoute>
                            <ProfileAddresses />
                          </ProtectedRoute>
                        }
                      />
                      <Route
                        path="/profile/history"
                        element={
                          <ProtectedRoute>
                            <ProfileHistory />
                          </ProtectedRoute>
                        }
                      />
                      <Route
                        path="/profile/saved"
                        element={
                          <ProtectedRoute>
                            <SavedProducts />
                          </ProtectedRoute>
                        }
                      />
                      <Route
                        path="/orders"
                        element={
                          <ProtectedRoute>
                            <MyOrders />
                          </ProtectedRoute>
                        }
                      />
                      <Route
                        path="/cart"
                        element={
                          <ProtectedRoute>
                            <Cart />
                          </ProtectedRoute>
                        }
                      />
                      <Route
                        path="/checkout"
                        element={
                          <ProtectedRoute>
                            <Checkout />
                          </ProtectedRoute>
                        }
                      />
                      <Route
                        path="/compare"
                        element={
                          <ProtectedRoute>
                            <Compare />
                          </ProtectedRoute>
                        }
                      />

                      {/* ðŸš« 404 */}
                      <Route path="*" element={<NotFound />} />
                    </Route>
                  </Routes>
                </Suspense>
              </SearchProvider>
            </CompareProvider>
          </WishlistProvider>
        </CartProvider>
      </AuthProvider>
    </ToastProvider>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import ReactDOM from 'react-dom/client';
import { BrowserRouter } from 'react-router-dom';
import { HelmetProvider } from 'react-helmet-async';
import App from './App';
import './assets/css/styles.css';

ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(
  <React.StrictMode>
    <HelmetProvider>
      <BrowserRouter>
        <App />
      </BrowserRouter>
    </HelmetProvider>
  </React.StrictMode>
);
